events.title: Nexus 6 released
events.summary: Google began selling the Nexus 6 — Motorola-built large Nexus with Lollipop.
events.about: Nexus and Pixel phones were Google's pure-Android reference hardware for developers. Motorola-built large nexus with lollipop. AOSP builds and CTS testing often used Pixel devices as the baseline.

narrative.whyChosen: The Nexus 6 was a flagship Google Android reference device.
narrative.whyImportant: Pixel/Nexus hardware defines the reference Android experience for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed first-party reference phones without OEM skin fragmentation.

events.title: AWS Lambda launched
events.summary: Amazon announced AWS Lambda at re:Invent on November 13, 2014 — event-driven functions billed per invocation without managing servers.
events.about: Lambda (`exports.handler`) launched serverless computing for production — API Gateway, S3 triggers, and cron jobs all invoke functions. Teams stopped patching EC2 for glue code; Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, and Azure Functions followed the same model.

narrative.whyChosen: Lambda popularized serverless functions as a cloud primitive.
narrative.whyImportant: It changed how teams deploy small services and event handlers.
narrative.problemSolved: Even small background jobs required always-on servers and capacity planning.
